audit.quality_scope: Execution and reward correctness only; no claim about convergence or perceptual speech-quality improvement

timing.method: Adjacent driver generate starts; exclude first three updates and final unclosed interval; includes generation, rewards, artifacts/conversion, training and weight publication, excludes initialization

single_process_control.interpretation: Main observed gain is on the serving/generation path. This is not a 32-to-64 GPU scaling factor: both runs use 64 GPUs. Native multiprocess also changes the upstream HTTP pool, so it does not isolate process count alone.

bottleneck_evidence.remaining_boundary_scope: The 3.88-second difference includes artifact/metric logging, batch conversion/splitting, serving completion and RPC-boundary overhead; individual contributions were not separately timed. The 7.02-second tail also includes reward completion. These overlapping quantities must not be added or labeled pure ASR/GPU time.
bottleneck_evidence.profile: One run-scoped busy data plane, final excluded rollout, 5 seconds, 111 successful GIL-held samples, 21 errors. Hot frames include HTTP connection-pool scanning and H11 relay. Fractions are not wall-clock shares or an all-data-plane census.
